name: String Catalog localization
description: Sets the project up for localization with a String Catalog: string extraction on, a Localizable.xcstrings with a plural example, and helpers for formatted values.

cost.note: Apple tooling; translation itself may be paid

usage: Write user-facing text as string literals in SwiftUI (`Text("Welcome")`) or `String(localized:)`; Xcode extracts them into `Localizable.xcstrings` on build. Use interpolation for counts so plural rules apply (`Text("\(count) items")`). Format numbers, dates and currency with `.formatted(...)`, never by string concatenation. Add languages in the catalog editor in Xcode.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify string-catalog-localization` on a Mac with XcodeGen.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
